subject: [SENDER] / [NAME] - Intro
text:
Hi [NAME],

Briefly - I wanted to reach out as we've recently onboarded LVT as a
customer and already work with many of leading AI video surveillance
companies (Rhombus Systems, Flock Safety, Actuate AI, Voxel AI, Milestone
Systems etc.) to help improve/scale their data curation & annotation
pipelines. We've been following Eagle Eye for a while now given the
momentum we're seeing with your peers. Appreciate you might be slightly
removed / your ML team are happy with their existing data infrastructure
setup - nonetheless I'd love the opportunity to introduce myself and get
your candid feedback on what we're building here at Encord.

Bit of context on Encord...we're a computer vision scale-up (recently
raised a $30M Series B) focused on consolidating data curation, annotation,
workflow management and model evaluation under one platform. We're
particularly differentiated in the way we handle video on the platform -
hence why we're seeing so much success in your space.

Would you be open to a quick virtual coffee next week? Happy to provide
availability for a 30 min slot if so.

subject: Woven by Toyota's data curation - why you might care
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

We've recently onboarded Woven by Toyota as customers, so I thought it'd make sense to reach out to see if we can help you and the team in a similar way.

Like hundreds of CV & ML Ops teams who have come to us with their challenges, Woven's Computer Vision team faced problems with data curation (Voxel51 & internal tools), where they lacked the speed & scalability required to efficiently search through their training datasets.

At Encord, we've built a high-performance architecture to support indexing and searching through billions of video and image data items (using embeddings visualisations, quality metric filters & natural language searches), enabling CV teams to avoid bottlenecks in model development. 

Are you open to exploring with me how Encord can help you and the team with your CV data development challenges?

How does a time suit for a call in the coming days? (Or any here: [LINK] suit?)

Very best,

We have an MSA in place with [COMPANY] as we work with some of the AI & Computer Vision teams there on use cases such as robotics and automated visual inspection. For context, sophisticated AI/ML teams like [COMPANY], Fraunhofer or Philips usually come to us when they're at the point of scaling their model training & data pipelines. Could be great to chat and get your feedback on what we've built for some of the other [COMPANY] teams. Open to catch up this week? My Thursday's looking pretty open right now.

subject: [Invite] Encord AI Leaders Dinner @ Il Buco 02/27
text:
Hi [NAME],​

Our Head of AI will be hosting an intimate roundtable dinner with customers & AI leaders and we'd love for you to join if you're available.

We've booked a private dining room at Il Buco in Noho on Thursday February 27th starting at 6:30pm, capping attendance to ~20 people. Join us to meet & share perspectives with fellow AI leaders on key trends heading into [YEAR].

Attendees include Co-Founders, CEO's, CTOs & Heads of ML from leading VC-backed scale-ups such as Intenseye, Captions, and Emergence as well as larger orgs such as Siemens Healthineers. 

In case you're not familiar with Encord - we're a London & SF-based data development platform (recently raised our Series B) built to help Multimodal AI teams get better models to market, faster. 

Thought it was a good opportunity to get connected - would you be interested in joining? I can send over an invite if so.

text:

Hope all's well! Reaching out because I saw that a couple people from your
team at [COMPANY] have been viewing our website so thought it was a
good time to reach out. I see you work on computer vision and GenAI model
development. We're actually the data development platform of choice for
CV/GenaAI teams used by the likes of Philips, Baker Hughes, Synthesia etc.

and model evaluation. Recently worked with another insurance customer
called Tractable to scale up their computer vision training models by
helping to keep quality assurance manageable as training models got more
complex.

You would be interested in having a quick chat to understand how we tend to
fit for teams like yours? Wide open next Thursday and Friday if it's of
interest.
